title: The Sphinx as a dynastic monument carved on an older bedrock outcrop

tellings.quote: So, I think the Sphinx itself is a dynastic monument >> Uh-huh. that was built on an existing bedrock outcrop within the Sphinx enclosure.

plain: The Great Sphinx at Giza was carved as a monument of Egypt's dynastic period, but it was carved on a bedrock outcrop that was already there inside the Sphinx enclosure. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum gives this as his own view, without naming a source. It would mean the site is older than the statue.
